purpose: Hold the factor-256 Torch fine trajectory fixed, then attach using every sample or every second sample. Compare a fixed match time with a stationary peak recomputed on the decimated samples to separate trajectory integration from attachment sampling.
interpretation: Development-only sampling attribution, not an independently converged waveform. Historical-source fidelity, Torch/JAX parity, NR accuracy, wider-domain convergence, and ROM qualification remain necessary.
